name: Christoffel Doll

events.title: Marriage
events.description: 'Johann Christoffel Doll, Hans Peter Dollen Sohn zu Erzweiler, und Sara, Joh. Peter Schuchen Tochter zu [Rats]weiler'

bioAdditions: Round 4 read his marriage in the Ulmet Lutheran register (S1). On 2 Mar 1704 Johann Christoffel Doll, son of Hans Peter Doll of Erzweiler, married Sara, daughter of Joh. Peter Schuch. The bride's village, read as Ratsweiler, is partly obscured. This proves his father's name and the family's village, Erzweiler, which is also the village of the earlier Dolls in the GEDBAS file. FamilySearch gives his baptism as 9 Jul 1671 at Ulmet (born 6 Jul) and his parents as Johannes Peter Doll (1647-1717) and Gertraud Fick (S2). It lists twelve children from 1705 to 1729, including Maria Engel (1717-1784), who married Jacob Sorber, and Johann Caspar (1722). It also says he died in 1739 'on Ship Samuel, crossing the Atlantic', which would explain why only his younger relatives qualified at Philadelphia. That death is unsourced. The existing bio's 'Stoffel Doll, 40' on the Samuel list would then be a son or nephew.

relationships.evidence: 1704 marriage names him son of Hans Peter Doll of Erzweiler
